added_failure_waiver: Explicit review dispatch waiver: lead ruling 2026-11-17 permits landing on the GPU gate; native CPU baseline and head abort in JAX compilation before summaries (both EXIT=-6/completed=false); combined-state H200 job 1324234 is reported by coordinator as 85 passed with one pre-existing failure deselected. No completed CPU failure-set pair exists; this review does not claim zero added failures or independently rerun that external H200 gate.

conditions.completed_comparison tests: Different-constraint reporting fails if ITER is band-gated or hides its fixed 25% gap/prior labels; same-constraint tests fail if MAST-U/TCV are not band-gated; scaled-control tests fail if nonstationarity or unqualification is accepted, a failed control is marked fired, or a valid stationary qualified 10% displacement is refused.
conditions.test_circuit_deselection_reads_multiple_: Fails if multiple top-level fragments cannot be read or an explicit false directive is treated as true.
conditions.test_comparison_receipts_delegate_to_dur: Fails if _write bypasses the owner (zero calls), invokes it repeatedly or with different options/payload, changes deterministic bytes, deletes another writer pending file, leaks temporary files, or calls the owner before rejecting nonfinite raw data; pending-file setup is a positive precondition rather than regression coverage.
conditions.test_conductor_currents_use_measurement_: Fails if conductor uncertainties, added current rows, request currents, stationary convergence, residuals or covariance dimension differ from the independent NumPy augmented design solve; unchanged original request current is a nonmutation check, not a self-confirming recovery check.
conditions.test_empty_coil_is_omitted_only_with_exp: Fails if a measured/wired coil is dropped, missing-data deselection is applied without the explicit flag, or an empty unwired coil cannot be omitted.
conditions.test_failed_forward_history_counts_nonfi: Fails if trips are computed from the three finite residual entries instead of the four attempted iterations, or if the finite-entry diagnostic incorrectly includes NaN; comparing the reported trip count with history.active_set_iterations is not tautological because the regressed finite-count implementation returns three.
conditions.test_fit_does_not_swallow_unrelated_tria: Fails if an unrelated observation RuntimeError on call eight is swallowed or reclassified as a qualification refusal.
conditions.test_fitted_circuit_binding_preserves_ou: Fails if active/passive arrays are split before flattening, shared contributions overwrite instead of summing (independent expected vector [2,5,3,5]), passive provenance is misidentified, or a modified measured witness of 99 A is accepted.
conditions.test_fitted_conductor_currents_refuse_mi: Fails if fitted currents proceed without aligned positive uncertainties.
conditions.test_fitted_replay_family_guard_refuses_: Fails if the 7.36% nonzero reference family is admitted, or the initial 1% positive control is refused.
conditions.test_fixed_pressure_and_quadratic_field_: Fails if the independent fixed case counts change, the zero-pressure basis gains a coefficient, zero/nonzero pressure is misclassified, or the quadratic profile loses its two live coefficients.
conditions.test_live_bernstein_space_admits_linear_: Fails if conversion coefficients differ from [1,-1], linear/zero profiles are refused, or a square profile is admitted into the linear live space.
conditions.test_loop_reader_preserves_polarity_and_: Fails if one-point polarity flips, a zero-extent path creates terms, the two signed half-circle terms differ from fixed coordinates/weights, or a slanted toroidal leg is accepted without distributed observations.
conditions.test_passive_current_uses_primitive_sigm: Fails if the homogeneous IDS time base is ignored in favour of the empty primitive signal time, interpolation is not 15 A/0.3 A at midpoint, or empty uncertainty data is fabricated.
conditions.test_passive_zero_turns_remain_zero_resp: Fails if explicit zero is replaced by one turn, negative turns lose their sign, or NaN turns are accepted.
conditions.test_probe_normal_uses_clockwise_angle_f: Fails on sign-reversed probe angle using the independent readings [2,-3,-2] for cardinal directions.
conditions.test_q95_uses_physical_flux_span_for_tru: Fails if normalization again uses the last sample at 0.97 instead of global axis/boundary: q95 becomes 0.9215 rather than independent 0.95 (or -92.15 rather than -95), creates a nonzero same-physics magnitude error and incorrectly fails the signed high-q band.
conditions.test_reference_prior_context_does_not_ad: Fails if ITER prior differences are hidden, nova acquires either prior, the age caveat disappears, or TCV is labelled as carrying those priors.
conditions.test_refused_residuals_preserve_strict_j: Fails if nonfinite residuals are emitted as raw NaN/Infinity, finite/unavailable states are mislabelled, strict serialization accepts raw NaN, or the prior receipt is overwritten on refusal.
conditions.test_row_agreement_exposes_a_reversed_cu: Fails if identical rows do not give zero, reversal does not give relative error two/gain minus one/three opposite signs, whitening loses its scale, or doubling does not give error one/gain two; these are arithmetic controls of the metric, not a solver-truth assertion.
conditions.test_row_replay_control_keeps_zero_exten: Fails if the zero row is dropped from its family, the independent scaled reference error is not 1/11, replacing scaled scores by unscaled scores still passes, or replaying 1.10 times the source is admitted within 5%.
conditions.test_segmented_loop_fitter_uses_every_si: Fails if either signed term is dropped or combined at the wrong radius, changing the independent design-matrix least-squares answer, or project silently accepts segmented loops at sensor-only points.
conditions.test_shared_magnetics_reconstruction: Input assertions fail on a wrong DD, inhomogeneous reference, unsuccessful stored reconstruction, mismatched channel counts, missing Ip sigma, misaligned sample geometry or a CPU physical run; terminal assertions refuse absence of a qualified forward state, nonstationary inverse, failed same-constraint bands or an invalid scaled fit.
conditions.test_shared_magnetics_reconstruction_obs: Positive current-bearing probe assertions fail if either plasma or conductor source path goes dead; family assertions fail on empty/nonfinite/zero-reference families, unscaled relative error >=5%, or scaled-reference error <=5%, independently comparing kernel predictions with stored EFIT rows.
conditions.test_stored_density_integral_keeps_sign_: Fails if source-cell area, current signs, nonzero-node count or grid spacings differ from the independent density-grid arithmetic, or an all-zero source is accepted.
conditions.test_supplied_equilibrium_reports_vertic: Fails if the known 0.3 m shift is not measured/removed correctly, a 10% current gap is miscomputed, q95 differs from -2.9, or fixed physical bands accept the excessive axis/current gaps.
conditions.test_unqualified_fit_start_is_not_backtr: Fails if a refused starting receipt is admitted or retried instead of raising after one call.
conditions.test_unqualified_fit_trial_backtracks_to: Fails if an unqualified full step propagates instead of halving, no rejected-trial receipt is retained, fixed qualification fields are wrong, call counts omit evaluations, or the recovered coefficients differ from independent generating truth.
conditions.test_unqualified_fit_trials_exhaust_the_: Fails if exhaustion returns normally or without accepted-fit/refused-forward receipts, the five fractions differ from [1,.5,.25,.125,.0625], refusals lose residual/reason, or accepted coefficients change despite every trial being rejected.
conditions.test_unqualified_forward_receipt_preserv: Fails if qualification is conflated with inner convergence, a refused receipt is returned as admitted, or residual/reason fields are lost; hardcoded expected convergence true differs deliberately from qualification false.
conditions.test_zero_extent_flux_row_retains_residu: Fails if zero-span rows are dropped, a half-span response is treated as full, fitted coefficients differ from independent NumPy weighted least squares, or the retained zero prediction has the wrong whitened residual.
